Rubio Warns State Dept. Staff on Ethics After Guilfoyle Ouster

U.S. Senator Marco Rubio has issued an ethics warning to State Department staff following the dismissal of Kimberly Guilfoyle. The warning reminds diplomats to avoid conflicts of interest.
